_comment: Host registry for `edva whereami` (lib/host-identity.js). Copy to system/hosts.json (gitignored). Resolution order: hostname/alias match first (instant), then the immutable hardware UUID as a fallback for renamed hosts. Get a Mac's UUID with: ioreg -rd1 -c IOPlatformExpertDevice | awk -F '"' '/IOPlatformUUID/{print $4}'. A host is production when "production": true (or role "production"); anything not listed resolves to role 'unknown'.

hosts.label: always-on host running the Edva stack
hosts.notes: process-manager + supervisors run here under launchd.

hosts.label: development laptop
hosts.notes: Code edits only; the agent stack does not run here.
